name: Configure comma-separated domain/address entries in .env; only matching single From addresses appear in notifications and read output, with redacted counts and no duplicates
Malformed or entry-less allow lists reject read and poll before contacting IMAP or publishing notifications
Unset or whitespace-only allow list preserves unrestricted mail delivery and degraded-header notifications
Persistent unfetchable prefix permits later allowed mail and retries recover allowed senders once while discarding blocked senders, at caps 20 and 1
